summary: Read-only security review of the Reemtsma production org (00D7Q000000KHD8UAO). Overall score 18/100 (red) with 5 critical findings, led by an unauthenticated guest-exposed webhook with SSRF and a hard-coded secret still open since the 2026-06-04 assessment.
